variants.candidate: You show your care in something made sooner than you say it, so the proof of you tends to pile up slowly and stay.
variants.original: Your heat leaves you as something solid, homes, habits, made things, and people trust what you build longer than what you say.

variants.candidate: You would rather let a new idea join what you know than take it on faith, and that leaves you slow to be convinced and slower to let go.
variants.original: Your mind gathers fuel long before it flares, and the ideas you feed patiently become the insights people call sudden.

variants.candidate: You feel a rule as a cool pull rather than a shout, and you hold yourself to it longer than anyone asked.
variants.original: Pressure reaches you cool and quiet, and the calm authorities you let bank your fire are the reason it lasts the night.

variants.candidate: You run on your own warmth more than on anyone's approval, so you tend to shine in company and go flat alone.
variants.original: Your strength arrives in blazes and burns out in private, and how you refill between fires decides almost everything else in your chart.

variants.candidate: You build by claiming what is in front of you and working it to a finish, so you keep what you build better than you keep your options open.
variants.original: You act by forging, heat applied until something keeps its shape, and your money follows the finished piece rather than the bright idea.
